product_overview: CampusExam is an institutional examination and evaluation platform for academic groups, faculty-authorized question banks, scheduled exam publication, and student attempt management. It provides role-scoped access for admins, faculty, students, and observers with auditability, proctor monitoring, and automated scoring.
core_goals: Support secure authentication and role-based access control for all users.
Enable admin-driven setup of groups, subjects, accounts, and faculty scopes.
Provide faculty with scoped question bank authoring and approval workflows.
Allow admins to publish scheduled exams with difficulty-balanced question sampling.
Support student exam attempts with autosave, concurrency protection, submission, and score release.
Expose live monitoring and immutable audit trail capabilities for observers and admins.

features.name: Authentication & System Core
features.description: Provides login, logout, identity lookup, health checks, and immutable audit visibility for authenticated users.
user_flows: GET /api/health -> Receive 200 with system status ok -> POST /api/login with valid username and password -> Receive 200 with token, role, userId, and username -> GET /api/me with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with current user identity and department scope

POST /api/login with missing username or password -> Receive 400 validation error -> POST /api/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 unauthorized -> POST /api/logout without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized

POST /api/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with Bearer token -> GET /api/audit with token -> Receive 200 with immutable audit trail records -> POST /api/logout with token -> Receive 200 empty response

features.name: Institutional Administration API
features.description: Lets administrators create academic groups, register subjects, provision accounts, and bind faculty to specific group-subject scopes.
user_flows: POST /api/login as ADMIN -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/groups with department, session, year, semester, and section -> Receive 200 with new group id -> POST /api/subjects with subject name -> Receive 200 with new subject id -> POST /api/accounts with faculty, student, and observer credentials -> Receive 200 with created account ids -> POST /api/faculty-scopes with faculty, group, and subject -> Receive 200 with scope id

POST /api/login as STUDENT -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/groups with administrative fields -> Receive 403 forbidden -> POST /api/accounts with role ADMIN and no permission -> Receive 403 forbidden

POST /api/login as ADMIN -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/groups with duplicate group details -> Receive 409 duplicate group -> POST /api/accounts with username collision -> Receive 409 username collision -> POST /api/faculty-scopes with existing faculty-group-subject binding -> Receive 409 scope already exists

features.name: Question Bank Authoring & Approval Lifecycle
features.description: Allows scoped faculty and admins to create draft banks, author MCQ questions, inspect scopes, and move banks through the approval lifecycle.
user_flows: POST /api/login as FACULTY -> Receive 200 with token -> GET /api/my-scopes with token -> Receive 200 with assigned faculty scopes -> POST /api/banks with subject, groups, and title inside scope -> Receive 200 with draft bank id -> POST /api/questions with MCQ fields and distinct options -> Receive 200 with question id -> POST /api/bank-state with bank and state=SUBMITTED -> Receive 200 with state transition id

POST /api/login as FACULTY -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/banks with subject and groups outside faculty scope -> Receive 403 forbidden -> POST /api/questions with duplicate prompt in a non-draft bank -> Receive 409 bank not in DRAFT or duplicate prompt -> POST /api/bank-state with invalid transition -> Receive 409 invalid bank transition

POST /api/login as ADMIN -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/bank-state with bank and state=APPROVED -> Receive 200 with approval transition id -> POST /api/bank-state with bank and state=ARCHIVED -> Receive 200 with archive transition id -> POST /api/questions to an approved bank -> Receive 409 bank not in DRAFT or duplicate prompt

features.name: Examination Scheduling & Publication API
features.description: Enables admins to publish approved question banks into scheduled exams with timing, attempts, pass marks, group targeting, and difficulty-based question selection.
user_flows: POST /api/login as ADMIN -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/publish with approved bank, title, instructions, mode, duration, attempts, opens, closes, pass, easy, medium, hard, and groups -> Receive 200 with exam id -> GET /api/exams with token -> Receive 200 with published exam list

POST /api/login as ADMIN -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/publish with bank in DRAFT or SUBMITTED state -> Receive 409 bank not approved -> POST /api/publish with pass score greater than selected marks total -> Receive 400 passing marks exceed total -> POST /api/publish with official mode and attempts greater than 1 -> Receive 400 official mode attempt limit violation

POST /api/login as ADMIN -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/publish with insufficient question mix for requested easy, medium, or hard counts -> Receive 409 insufficient questions for difficulty mix -> POST /api/publish to a group with no eligible students -> Receive 409 no eligible students

features.name: Student Examination Runner & Evaluation API
features.description: Supports students starting assigned exams, loading masked attempt content, autosaving answers with version checks, sending heartbeats, submitting attempts, and receiving released scores.
user_flows: POST /api/login as STUDENT -> Receive 200 with token -> GET /api/exams with token -> Receive 200 with assigned exams -> POST /api/start with an assigned exam id during the availability window -> Receive 200 with attempt id -> GET /api/attempt with attempt id -> Receive 200 with masked questions and hidden answer keys -> POST /api/answer with attempt, position, choice, review, and version -> Receive 200 with saved status and incremented version -> POST /api/heartbeat with attempt and pending count -> Receive 200 with active status -> POST /api/submit with attempt id -> Receive 200 with submitted status

POST /api/login as STUDENT -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/start with an exam not assigned to the student -> Receive 404 exam not assigned -> POST /api/start with an exam outside the availability window -> Receive 409 exam outside availability window or attempt limit exceeded -> POST /api/answer with stale version -> Receive 409 stale answer version

POST /api/login as ADMIN -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/release with exam id before exam closes or while unsubmitted attempts remain -> Receive 409 exam window not closed or unsubmitted attempts open -> POST /api/release after all attempts are submitted and window is closed -> Receive 200 with release id -> GET /api/attempt after release -> Receive 200 with unmasked correct answers and explanations

features.name: Observer Proctoring, Monitoring, and Audit Visibility
features.description: Provides read-only exam visibility, live candidate telemetry, and audit trail access for observers and admins.
user_flows: POST /api/login as OBSERVER -> Receive 200 with token -> GET /api/exams with token -> Receive 200 with visible exams -> GET /api/monitor with exam id -> Receive 200 with live proctor candidate status array -> GET /api/audit with token -> Receive 200 with audit records

POST /api/login as OBSERVER -> Receive 200 with token -> POST /api/start with exam id -> Receive 403 forbidden -> POST /api/release with exam id -> Receive 403 forbidden -> POST /api/accounts with admin operation -> Receive 403 forbidden
POST /api/login as ADMIN -> Receive 200 with token -> GET /api/monitor with exam id -> Receive 200 with live telemetry -> GET /api/audit -> Receive 200 with immutable audit trail
